title: Virtual-table global-to-connection error-message import

scope.rationale: sqlite3VtabImportErrmsg crosses allocator domains: it conditionally consumes sqlite3_vtab.zErrMsg from the global allocator, replaces the Vdbe connection-owned error, and clears the virtual-table owner even when duplication fails.
excluded_responsibilities: Creation of the module error message

external_source_responsibilities: Exact sqlite3_vtab.zErrMsg and Vdbe.zErrMsg layout owners
dependencies.caller_closure: The active import function is assigned. Vtab callbacks that populate the public field and final Vdbe destruction remain dependency/integration work.

inputs: Vdbe with optional connection-owned zErrMsg and sqlite3_vtab with optional global-owned zErrMsg
outputs: unchanged state when incoming message is null; otherwise connection duplicate or null on OOM, and cleared incoming owner
contracts.ownership: An incoming message causes the prior Vdbe message to be consumed, attempts a connection-owned duplicate, always consumes the original global allocation, and clears sqlite3_vtab.zErrMsg.
contracts.state_and_results: No return value. Null incoming state leaves even the prior Vdbe message unchanged.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callback or I/O; caller holds connection mutex. Global and connection allocators are both invoked.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Duplicate OOM leaves Vdbe.zErrMsg null, marks sticky connection OOM, and still frees/clears the original virtual-table message.

representation_differences: sqlite3_free maps to the source-shaped process memory manager while sqlite3DbStrDup/free map to the connection allocator; both preserve their distinct allocator domains.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker imports a live global message over a live connection message, verifies the null-incoming no-op, then disables lookaside and forces the connection duplicate allocation to fail. C and Zig compare all owner states in a 366-observation trace.
internal_observations: OOM null destination and consumed incoming owner
oracle.normalization: Pointers normalize to null/non-null and free-list membership; message bytes and sticky OOM state are exact.

assurance.oom: Deterministic no-lookaside duplication OOM verifies null destination, sticky OOM, and unconditional source-owner consumption.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or callback; connection mutex remains integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: The source accepts only live messages from the documented allocator domains; worker creates those exact owners.
assurance.continuation: Null input preserves prior error; success remains readable; OOM leaves both message fields null and cleanup safe.
assurance.performance: One conditional, at most one connection duplicate, and two frees preserve source complexity.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact PublicVtab, Vdbe, global allocator, and connection allocator. Runtime vtab call sites remain handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Connect virtual-table callback failure paths and Vdbe deletion.

independent_review.notes: Requires callback integration, destruction closure, and independent review.
